## F — Application documents, testing and license conditions
Research inventory: 47 primary rule blocks in C and 52 continuation blocks in C2, each with an exact physical-page anchor.
VERIFY: NE-sec02-PASS covers absent official exam counts, scoring and time limits; NE-sec02-CURRENCY covers unaccepted edition evidence and unknown revision frequency.
NE-sec02-MARKET covers unresearched market demand; NE-sec02-TEARDOWN covers unresearched competitor comparisons.
The registrar footer crop does not recognize printed page labels; physical PDF pages are authoritative. Immigration and licensing requirements need current official confirmation before outward use; no legal advice or current-service guarantee is claimed.
The source map and authorship record remain local; the deterministic compiler indexes the exact accepted fact sentences.
